draft.transcript:
Hi, it's Peter Muthoni here, Director for Feed and Forage Systems, calling in my report for the second quarter of the year.
Things are moving along nicely, I'd put us at amber, mainly because of the timeline slip I'll mention.
In terms of numbers, we're at about sixty percent, call it sixty, on the dot.
The big win this quarter was finalising the multi-country trial protocol for the new drought-tolerant forage varieties; all four partner countries have now signed off on it.
The main challenge has been staff turnover in the trial coordination team - we lost two research associates and that slowed down site preparation in Ethiopia.
On support, honestly, nothing needed from corporate right now,  we're managing this internally.
That's it from my side.
